title: React Fundamentals
tagline: Go from zero to shipping interactive UIs with React 19.
description: React is how most product teams build interfaces today, and the fundamentals have never been smaller or clearer. You start from an empty folder, set up React 19 with Vite, and learn the handful of ideas that do most of the work: components, props, state, events and effects. Every lesson ends with something you build and run in the browser.

The whole course builds one real app, a Watchlist for the movies you want to see. You add titles through a form, mark them watched, filter the list, and keep it in localStorage so it survives a refresh. In the last section you style it with Tailwind CSS v4, deploy it to Vercel, and leave with a live URL and a clear plan for what to learn next.
audience: Career switchers and junior developers who know some HTML, CSS and JavaScript and want to build real interfaces with React.
prerequisites: Comfortable JavaScript basics: variables, functions, arrays, objects, arrow functions and array methods like map and filter.
learnItems: Build interactive UIs with components, props, and state
Set up a modern React 19 + Vite workflow from scratch
Handle events, forms, and controlled inputs confidently
Manage side effects with useEffect the right way
Compose complex screens from small, testable pieces
Ship a finished project to production on Vercel
